Kit summary

Basic ThunderboltBasic
Deals 3 stages of 170% ATK DMG each to a single enemy. Meanwhile, reduces their Turn Meter by 10%, or 15% when landing a Crit.
Basic FlareActive
Deals 390% ATK DMG to a single enemy and 2 other random enemies. Crit is guaranteed for targets with debuffs.
Basic Dark ErosionActive
Deals 220% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 100% chance to reduce their Tenacity by 60% for 2 turns.
Elemental EvolutionPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Melchio is immune to [Silence], [Horrify], and [Provoke]. Also, the CD of all his skills won't be affected by other effects. At the beginning of each wave and Melchio's turn, Melchio gains 1 layer of [Thunder], [Fire], and [Darkness] and advances corresponding skills based on the layers of each element: 1 layer - basic skills; 2 layers - intermediate skills; 3 layers - advanced skills. When Melchio casts skills proactively, all layers of corresponding elements will be consumed. [Thunder], [Fire], and [Darkness] won't be removed upon death. Melchio will cast Basic Thunderbolt when launching counterattacks or pursue-and-attacks and no layers of [Thunder] will be consumed.
Elemental Orb Lv.1Before casting an intermediate skill or advanced skill, Melchio gains the corresponding effect based on the element that is about to be consumed: [Thunder]: Increases Effect Hit by 8%; [Fire]: Increases ATK by 8%; [Darkness]: Increases Max HP by 8%. Each of the bonuses mentioned above can be gained up to 5 times and will not be removed when he dies or at the wave transition.
Elemental Orb Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, Melchio gains 1 more layer of [Thunder], [Fire], and [Darkness]. Melchio will gain different effects at the end of his turn based on the element layer(s) consumed during his turn: When less than 2 layers are consumed, Melchio will own up to 3 layers of [Thunder], [Fire], and [Darkness] each. When 2 or more layers are consumed, restores self HP by 12% of Max HP and gains 12% Turn Meter.
Intermediate ThunderstormBasicExclusive Lv.3
Deals 4 stages of 200% ATK DMG each to a single enemy. The 4th stage of attack has a 60% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn. This attack has an additional 30% Piercing Rate.
Elemental Orb Lv.3When Melchio casts an intermediate skill or advanced skill, grants the skill extra effect based on the element consumed: [Thunder]: Ignores [Shield], [DMG Immunity], and [Immortal]; increases DMG dealt to the Boss by 100%. Each stage reduces the target's Turn Meter by 15% and additionally reduces 10% of the target's Turn Meter when landing a Crit. [Fire]: Crit is guaranteed. This skill gains a 40% Crit DMG bonus and has an additional 25% Piercing Rate against targets with debuffs. [Darkness]: Deals extra DMG equal to 12% of the target's Max HP, caps at 300% of Melchio's ATK.
